es.resumen: Dani es muy cariñoso , nada reactivo
es.historia: Dani es amable , alegre , dócil , buenos con  niños , bueno con otros perros , energía media , le gusta jugar , amaría un jardín pero seguro se adapta a una casa sin jardín saliendo a sus caminatas.

en.resumen: Dani is very affectionate, not reactive at all.
en.historia: Dani is kind, cheerful, and docile; he is good with children and other dogs. He has a medium energy level and enjoys playing. He would love a garden, but he would certainly adapt to a home without one, provided he gets taken out for walks.
